kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتراحم (form VI)
# نَتَرَاحَمُ (natarāḥamu) /na.ta.raː.ħa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَاحَمَ (tarāḥama)
# نَتَرَاحَمَ (natarāḥama) /na.ta.raː.ħa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَاحَمَ (tarāḥama)
# نَتَرَاحَمْ (natarāḥam) /na.ta.raː.ħam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَرَاحَمَ (tarāḥama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
